text: et-wb water-balance-based evapotranspiration (etwb) for 56 large river basins (>10⁵ km²) worldwide over 1983–2016. for each basin, observed runoff is combined with four precipitation products (gpcc, cru, mswep, gpcp) and three terrestrial water storage change estimates (jpl, gsfc, csr), yielding 12 annual etwb series and a bayesian three-cornered-hat merged series recommended as a benchmark for global et models. basin boundaries are provided as shapefiles and as a 0.25° netcdf mask. 1983–2016 年全球 56 个大型流域（面积大于 10⁵ km²）的水量平衡蒸散发（etwb）基准数据集。对每个流域，将实测径流与四种降水产品（gpcc、cru、mswep、gpcp）和三种陆地水储量变化估计（jpl、gsfc、csr）组合，得到 12 条逐年 etwb 序列，并用基于贝叶斯的三角帽方法融合得到推荐用于检验全球蒸散发模型的基准序列。同时提供流域边界的 shapefile 和 0.25° netcdf 掩膜。 etwb

title: Water Cycle and Ecohydrology
text: water cycle and ecohydrology 水循环和生态水文 the team investigates how global warming and human activities are altering fundamental water cycle processes. they seek to reconcile different data sources (like satellite, model (such as pml-v2 evapotranspiration and hbv-pml hydrological models), and ground observations) to better quantify these changes, asking critical questions such as why parts of the water cycle appear to be stagnating despite warming, and how human actions reshape water availability and ecosystem functions—like the roles of forests as “sponges” or “pumps”—at regional and global scales. 团队研究全球变暖和人类活动如何改变水循环的基本过程，融合卫星、模型（如 pml-v2 蒸散发模型与 hbv-pml 水文模型）和地面观测以更好地量化这些变化，并回答关键问题：为何升温背景下部分水循环过程反而趋于停滞，人类活动又如何在区域和全球尺度上重塑水资源可用性和生态系统功能，例如森林究竟扮演“海绵”还是“水泵”的角色。

title: PML_v2
text: pml_v2 pml_v2 蒸散发产品 penman-monteith-leuning evapotranspiration v2 (pml_v2) products include evapotranspiration (et), its three components, and gross primary production (gpp) at 500m and 8-day resolution during 2000-2023. penman-monteith-leuning 蒸散发第二版（pml_v2）产品提供 2000—2023 年 500 m、8 天分辨率的蒸散发及其三个组分和总初级生产力（gpp）。

title: HBV-PML
text: hbv-pml hbv-pml 模型 the hbv-pml model, provides critical data support for global water resource assessments. this innovative model integrates the remote sensing evapotranspiration model pml with the classical hydrological model hbv, significantly improving the accuracy of evapotranspiration simulation through remote sensing observations. it effectively overcomes the limitations of traditional models in representing vegetation dynamics. hbv-pml 模型将遥感蒸散发模型 pml 与经典水文模型 hbv 相结合，利用遥感观测显著提高蒸散发模拟精度，克服了传统模型难以刻画植被动态的局限，为全球水资源评估提供关键数据支撑。

title: Water-Related Disasters and Security
text: water-related disasters and security 水灾害和水安全 this theme focuses on the mechanisms and impacts of extreme hydrological events, including droughts and floods. the group studies how droughts develop and propagate through different environmental layers, how flood patterns have evolved in china over decades, and how to enhance societal and ecological resilience to water-related extremes in a changing climate. 这一方向聚焦干旱和洪水等极端水文事件的机理与影响，研究干旱如何在不同环境圈层中发展和传播，中国洪水格局在数十年间如何演变，以及如何在气候变化下增强社会和生态系统对水相关极端事件的韧性。

title: Forest Fire & Flood Ecological-Hydrological Effects
title_zh: 林火与洪水的生态水文效应
text: forest fire & flood ecological-hydrological effects 林火与洪水的生态水文效应 the research explores the impacts of bushfires on hydrological processes in southeast australia, particularly focusing on changes in water balance and flood magnitudes. one study examines the effects of the 2009 victorian bushfires on water balance in eight forested catchments, finding a reduction in evapotranspiration and an increase in streamflow, leading to a long-term decline in water storage in burned areas. another study investigates the 2019-2020 mega forest fires, showing that these fires significantly amplified flood magnitudes, especially in regions with winter-dominated rainfall. 研究关注澳大利亚东南部林火对水文过程的影响，特别是水量平衡和洪水量级的变化。其中一项研究分析 2009 年维多利亚州林火对 8 个森林流域水量平衡的影响，发现火后蒸散发减少、径流增加，过火区水储量长期下降；另一项研究表明，2019—2020 年特大林火显著放大了洪水量级，在冬季降雨主导的地区尤为明显。

title: Innovating Water Science
text: innovating water science 水文水资源与新技术 the group leverages advanced technologies such as high-resolution remote sensing and artificial intelligence (ai) to improve the monitoring and prediction of hydrological processes. they develop fine-scale datasets for evapotranspiration and vegetation productivity, integrate ai with physical models to enable better forecasting in ungauged basins, and work toward real-time flood prediction systems that support water resources management under climate change. 团队利用高分辨率遥感和人工智能等先进技术改进水文过程的监测与预测：研发蒸散发和植被生产力的精细尺度数据集，融合人工智能与物理模型以提升无资料流域的预报能力，并致力于发展实时洪水预报系统，为气候变化下的水资源管理提供支撑。

title: AI for Hydrology Modeling
text: ai for hydrology modeling 人工智能水文建模 we introduce an ai-driven transformer-based deep learning model to address data gaps in grace and grace follow-on satellite data. by integrating meteorological and hydrological features like temperature, precipitation, and evapotranspiration, the model effectively fills the 11-month data gap, showing superior accuracy, particularly in arid regions. the transformer-based approach outperforms traditional methods, demonstrating the potential of ai in enhancing satellite data continuity and reliability for environmental monitoring. 我们提出基于 transformer 的人工智能深度学习模型，用于填补 grace 与 grace follow-on 卫星观测之间的数据缺口。模型融合气温、降水和蒸散发等气象水文要素，有效填补约 11 个月的观测空缺，精度优于传统方法，在干旱区表现尤为突出，展示了人工智能在提升卫星数据连续性与可靠性方面的潜力。

title: CAS-Canglong
text: cas-canglong 中科苍龙 we present a novel ai-based approach for sub-seasonal to seasonal (s2s) global sea surface temperature (sst) prediction, using a 3d transformer model called cas-canglong. by leveraging the self-attention mechanism inherent in transformer architectures, the model efficiently handles the complexities of ocean-atmosphere interactions and improves prediction accuracy. compared to traditional physics-based models, cas-canglong demonstrates superior skill in predicting sst patterns, enhancing computational efficiency and forecasting accuracy for up to three months in advance. this approach shows great potential for improving predictions of extreme weather events like droughts and floods, as well as for future climate studies. 我们提出面向全球海表温度次季节至季节（s2s）预测的人工智能方法——三维 transformer 模型“中科苍龙”（cas-canglong）。模型利用自注意力机制刻画复杂的海气相互作用，与传统物理模式相比，在最长三个月的提前期内具有更高的海温预测技巧和计算效率，可为干旱、洪水等极端事件预报和未来气候研究提供支撑。
